recipes.name: Sugar Free Eggnog
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 ounce) package sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix

steps.text: Whisk nonfat milk, sugar-free pudding mix, sweetener, rum extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg together in a large bowl until well combined, about 2 minutes. If too thick, add more milk and sweetener.

raw_recipe.headline: Sugar Free Eggnog
raw_recipe.description: This is a creamy, sugar-free version of a Christmas favorite. It is best to make it just before serving. It’s easy to make and perfect for sipping.

review.reviewBody:
I made the nog with soy milk and pumpkin pie spice mixture and it was wonderful!
It has all the creamy, spicy holiday flavor of egg nog without all the fat and sugar.
Yum!

I changed this up a bit and it was perfect for my husband and myself. I did 5 cups of almond milk - 1/4 cup of heavy whipping cream - 4 ice cubes - 1 teaspoon of organic nutmeg - 1/4 plus 1/8 teaspoon of organic cinnamon, 1 packet of organic stevia -1 teaspoon of rum extract - 1 ounce pack of sugar free vanilla pudding. Added pack of pudding last and slowly so it would mix well. Added 4 ice cubes and blended again. Left in fridge for 30 minutes before trying. Shook container before pouring it make sure spices mixed well. This was thicker and had an amazing taste. For those of us concerned with sugar and carbs....this hit the spot. The heavy whipping cream adds a few more calories per cup, but, not the sugar.

So happy to find a way to be apart of the holiday season and watch the sugar at the same time. I used sugar free vanilla almond milk. I only wanted 1/2 the recipe so I used 1/2 oz sugar free vanilla pudding mix and 2 1/2 cps almond milk and 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice. As I mixed I ended up adding the rest of the pudding mix. It came out great. And the pumpkin pie spice made it taste more like real eggnog. I figured I would add real rum when it became drinking time. Enjoy

This is really good, considering that it's OK for people who need to lose weight and/or are diabetic. But here's an important thing. The pudding tends to settle to the bottom of the pitcher no matter how hard you whisk it. To avoid that, put two cups of the milk in a blender and slowly add the pudding mix. Blend it like crazy until it gets a little frothy. Then add it to the other three cups. That will eliminate most of the lumps and silt on the bottom. And use real rum. Cruzan is aged, very good, and affordable.

I added some Ground Cloves for extra spice. Plus like someone else adviced I used the blender and added a handful of ice. We let it set in the fridge for about 15 minutes for it to thicken a bit. Great recipe for diabetics and NON diabetics.

I've been looking for YEARS for a great low-fat sugar-free eggnog recipe and this is the best one I have ever tried. It tastes just like the real thing! I make mine in a blender with 2 or 3 ice cubes (add ice cubes at the very last, after blending all the other ingredients) and it whips up thick and rich.

This may be my favorite ever substitution recipe!! I love eggnog lattes and have not had one in years due to sugar and fat content. I warmed mine up in the microwave then stirred in some instant coffee - heaven! My husband (who doesn't give a hoot about sugar or fat) is enjoying his glass over ice with rum! So happy to find this recipe and not feel deprived this season!

I love this stuff. I made mine with 4 cups of unsweetened almond milk and added a short of sugar free french vanilla torani syrup as a sweetener. Making it with this almond milk reduced the calories to 68 per 8 ounce serving. YUM! Thanks for the recipe

I only wanted a cup for the evening. Didn't have any instant pudding but I did have a container of sugar-free snack pack pudding. Used 1 cup milk, container of pudding, 2 egg yolks, pinch of salt, Splenda to taste and garnished with nutmeg. It was good!

I'd just use the soynog at stores, but its so full of sugar! I made this one with almond milk, so it wasn't quite as thick, and had a slightly nutty flavor which required quite a bit more spices and rum flavor but overall great recipe for those who can't have dairy (use soy or almond)/sugar or either.

My kids love eggnog, and just looking at this recipe I think I'll make it this year instead of buying. It will be so much cheaper. I'm going to try it with pumpkin spice jello instant pudding. My kids love the pumpkin spice eggnog we get every year.
This is the recipe I've been looking for. I used to make it years ago. Thank you for posting it.I had lost the recipe.
Just like the real thing.
The only change I made was to substitute Soy Milk to reduce carbs. It did make it pretty creamy. I found it pretty favorless for some reason. Didn't remind me of real eggnog.
Non fat milk basically defeats the purpose, as sugar is still there to make up for the lack of fat. This is definitely not sugar free as it claims

love love love it!....a new Christmas tradition!.....no more store bought eggnog in this house!....i followed the recipe except i left out the sweetner.......im glad i did ,,,,,,,,,,,i think it would have been too sweet with it.......my 3 kids loved it too!...easy to make.....my daughter had fun helping!...thank you for the great recipe!
LOVED IT!! I NEEDED A COUPLE OF MORE SPLENDAS!! AND I PUT LITTLE TOO MUCH RUM EXTRACT, BUT VERY GOOD AND HIT THAT EGG NOG SPOT!!!!

This was just ok. Definitely did not taste like eggnog, more like thin vanilla pudding with spices. Letting it sit in the fridge for 30 minutes is a must if you want your drink to be thicker. It's not a bad taste, it's just not eggnog.
My fiance thought this was a 3 star eggnog...I did not care for it. Sorry, not for me.
Super easy and a great lighter alternative to traditional egg nog. Thanks!!
